jobs.name: sort-outlined
jobs.prompt: Production-ready standalone game UI asset for an elegant classical music theater game. Flat clean illustrated finish, orthographic front view, no perspective. Render on uniform pure black #000000 technical background for later transparency extraction. The black background is NOT part of the asset. No text, no labels, no watermark. Redraw ONLY the three curved arrows circular clockwise recycle/organize glyph in the reference. Keep its balanced circular shape, three separated arrowheads, large hollow center, same warm ivory fill #EEE8D8 and subtle antique gold edge. ADD a crisp continuous DARK INK NAVY #283447 OUTLINE around EVERY outer and inner edge of each arrow, including arrowheads. Dark outline width 5 percent of overall glyph diameter, bold enough to remain clear at 32px on pale ivory parchment. Outline must be distinctly navy, never pure black. Simple flat edges, no shadow, no glow. Glyph centered at 70 percent canvas width. NO button rectangle, NO filled disk, NO surrounding ring, NO background tile. Only three outlined arrow shapes.
